browser_target.limits: Installed version only, isolated profile, synthetic keyboard/composition/clipboard where used; not recent-two-version, reader or physical-device acceptance.

checks: keyboard toggling preserves the same focused input and open disclosure; persistent URL reflects lifecycle change
preset undo and reload preserve explicitly empty modes with custom lifecycle selection
temporary isolation shares the visible line and exits to the earlier persistent choices
snapshot changes retain React control identities, native open disclosures and display options while legacy line coverage stays explicit
grade/status legend buttons support Space, retain focus and remain available after disabling the last state
line legend groups use configured operator name or explicit unknown operator; keyboard opens colour provenance and confidence
palette recovery updates real line colours without replacing focused React input or resetting its choice
390px simulation retains all presets, at least 44px touch targets, keyboard-collapsible line panel, readable colour provenance and no horizontal overflow
scope: Local Chrome React ownership and keyboard/disclosure continuity, actual snapshots and 390px simulation; not real-device or full accessibility acceptance
